annotations.title: Check an FCC ID's form and where to read its grant

description: Check whether a string has the form of an FCC ID and split it into grantee code and product code, by the FCC's own rules (a grantee code is 3 characters when it starts with a letter and 5 when it starts with a digit 2 to 9, never holds 0 or 1; a product code is 1 to 14 capital letters, digits and hyphens). It then says where to look the ID up and what to read on each grant before using a pre-certified radio module: the modular approval type, the grant's conditions (antennas, co-location, OEM-only sale, RF exposure), frequencies and power. It is NOT a lookup: it does NOT say whether the ID has been granted and does NOT return the grant. The FCC's equipment database refuses automated requests and has no API for grants, so this tool makes no network request and tells you where to read instead. Free with a DatasheetVend API key (no credits), no model call, reads no account data, stores nothing.

fcc_id.description: The FCC ID as printed, for example '2AC7Z-ESPWROOM32'. A leading 'FCC ID:' is ignored.
